grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时的疑问形式与描述性场景。

points.title: 过去进行时疑问
points.explanation: 把 was/were 提前：What were you doing at that time? 否定 wasn't/weren't + V-ing。

examples.en: Where were you standing when the accident happened?
examples.cn: 事故发生时你站在哪里？

points.title: wear 与 put on
points.explanation: wear 表"穿着"的状态（进行时描写衣着），put on 表"穿上"的瞬间动作：He was wearing a hat and a dark coat.
